retired_at.description: When it was retired; null while active.

updated_by.description: Who made the last write (the create, else the last edit).

version.description: Send it back as the PATCH precondition.

CharacterChoice.description: One of a party member's active characters, a candidate for the run.

CharacterClash.description: The same character (picked or inferred) on another run of this boss week (the configured reset) for a boss this run has too, at any difficulty: the weekly clear limit. A warning only; a pick always saves. Cancelled runs never clash.

day.description: Day index within the boss week (0 = reset day).

time.description: HH:MM; null for an own-time run.

bosses.description: The other run's boss tokens this run shares by boss.

inferred.description: The character is inferred on the other run, not picked.

RunCharacterSlot.description: One party member on a run. `candidates` are their active characters (no level filter), oldest first; empty when they have none. `picked` is the stored pick while it names a candidate; `inferred`, only with nothing picked, is the one candidate when there is exactly one: recomputed on every read, never stored. `version` is the slot version a pick sends back (0 while nothing is stored).

CharacterPick.description: Request body of `PUT /api/admin/runs/{id}/characters/{member}`. `character_id` names one of the member's active characters, or is null to clear the pick (required either way, else 422 `invalid`); `version` is the slot version read (else 422 `version_required`; another is 409 `stale`).

CharacterCreate.description: Request body of `POST /api/admin/members/{id}/characters`. `ign` is 4-12 letters or digits, unique per `world` case-insensitively (retired characters included; else 422 `ign_taken`); `world` is the region, default `msea`; `class` is at most 32 characters (empty: none); `level` 1-300. A member's first active character is their main whatever `role` says; otherwise `role` defaults to `alt`, and `main` takes the crown (the current main becomes an alt in the same write).

CharacterPatch.description: Request body of `PATCH /api/admin/characters/{id}`. `version` is the row version the edit was made from (else 422 `version_required`; another version is 409 `stale`). An omitted field is kept; `class`/`level` `null` (or an empty class) clears it; `retired: true` retires (keeping the first time), `false` restores. `role: main` takes the crown; without `role`, an active character with no other active main becomes the main and a restored main becomes an alt while another main is active. The main cannot be retired or made an alt while the member has other active characters (409 `main_required`).
